observed_constraints: Internal CBMCall carries site_start_byte/site_end_byte. Sequential and parallel CALLS properties retain line, callee, confidence, strategy and candidate count, omitting those spans.
Unresolved ordinary calls continue without a callsite record in parallel resolution; sequential processing retains an aggregate unresolved counter.
Candidate count/heuristic confidence is not a candidate target set or proof of exact binding. A missing edge cannot distinguish absent call from unresolved call.
Reconstructing every site from a separate source parser would make that parser the fact owner; it does not qualify this pin as the complete evidence store.

incremental.assessment: incremental implementation exists; frozen update equivalence not executed

lifecycle.assessment: local CLI namespace is source-supported; runtime coexistence and cleanup unmeasured
lifecycle.configuration_boundary: A unique CBM_RUNTIME_DIR scopes rendezvous/cohort/project locks on POSIX, plus separate CBM_CACHE_DIR and XDG_CONFIG_HOME. HOME/cache alone do not scope coordination. Default MCP, async index, install/update/uninstall and daemon control are excluded.
lifecycle.documentation_discrepancy: README 112-132 says one-shot CLI connects to/starts the daemon. Exact main.c 2857-3021 instead runs a local server and returns before the MCP bootstrap path. The prior README-only rejection is superseded.

missing_prerequisites: A supported per-callsite export with original byte spans, all unknowns and candidate sets is required before reconsidering this exact backend role.
Then prove isolated coexistence/cancellation/cleanup, source safety, update equivalence, bounded query work and optional installation on the frozen workload.
candidates.next_action: No candidate execution for this complete-backend screening. A future upstream supported evidence interface or separately authorized enrichment-only experiment may reopen the decision.

query.assessment: output bounds and generation/result-bound cursors exist; exposed max_rows is explicitly a presentation budget, not evaluation work budget

candidates.reason: The supported graph surface cannot supply the frozen per-call byte ranges and every unresolved ordinary callsite. Internal AST spans are not exported by either CALLS emitter; unresolved ordinary calls are dropped. This rejection is an evidence-contract decision, not a daemon-isolation claim.

source_safety.assessment: source-supported symlink exclusion and CBM_ALLOWED_ROOT containment; boundary/race checks not executed

supported_interfaces: cli index_repository with async=false and persistence=false

evidence.assessment: CALL nodes precede target linking and can preserve unresolved sites; exact four-language range/construct qualification pending
evidence.certainty_boundary: Export every CALL including unlinked/unknown nodes and every candidate relation. Label name/type recovery and NaiveCallLinker edges as inferred candidates; STATIC_DISPATCH and one matching name do not certify exact target binding. Preserve malformed/unsupported/skipped files and all frozen unknowns.

coexistence.required_proof: Run only an owned finite process group or cgroup after setup approval. Record scoped process/path/resource state before and after, prove existing sessions and caches remain unaffected, and never signal or reconfigure unowned processes.
